# Devmark

> Devmark is a web and software development agency based in Lima, Peru. It designs, builds, and maintains websites, custom software, AI chatbots, and digital marketing programs for businesses in Peru and remotely across Latin America.

## Company facts

- Legal/brand name: Devmark
- Headquarters: Lima, Peru
- Coverage area: all of Peru (on-site and remote), plus remote clients across Latin America
- Website: https://devmarkpe.com
- Email: contacto@devmarkpe.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +51 975 646 074
- Business hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 (America/Lima)
- Languages: Spanish (primary, devmarkpe.com/*) and English (devmarkpe.com/en/*)
- Social: Instagram @devmark.pe, Facebook @devmark.pe, LinkedIn /company/devmarkpe

## Services

Each service below has a Spanish page and an English page. Prices are starting prices in Peruvian soles (S/) for the entry-level plan; final pricing depends on project scope.

- Custom web development — corporate sites, landing pages, PWAs, from S/ 1200.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/desarrollo-web-a-medida
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/custom-web-development

- CMS and platform development — WordPress and Shopify sites and online stores, from S/ 1800.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/desarrollo-cms
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/cms-development

- Custom software development — ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms, and APIs, from S/ 3000.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/desarrollo-software
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/custom-software-development

- Process automation — workflow automation with Zapier, Make, or custom APIs, from S/ 1500.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/automatizacion-procesos
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/process-automation

- AI chatbots — chatbots for websites, e-commerce, and social media trained on the client's own data, from S/ 1200.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/chatbots-ia
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/ai-chatbots

- UI/UX design — user research, prototyping, and interface design, from S/ 1800.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/diseno-ui-ux
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/ui-ux-design

- Digital marketing — paid advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads), content, and email marketing, from S/ 700/month.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/marketing-digital
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/digital-marketing

- SEO and web optimization — technical SEO, organic traffic growth, conversion rate optimization, from S/ 300/month.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/seo-optimizacion
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/seo-optimization

- Web support and maintenance — updates, backups, uptime monitoring, and technical support, from S/ 60/month.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/soporte-mantenimiento
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/support-maintenance

- Technology consulting — digital transformation strategy and tooling advice, from S/ 30.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/servicios/consultoria-tecnologica
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/services/tech-consulting

- Hosting and domains — hosting, domains, corporate email, and SSL as an official Hostinger partner, with an extra 20% discount.
  ES: https://devmarkpe.com/hosting
  EN: https://devmarkpe.com/en/hosting

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Devmark operates primarily in Peru and serves clients remotely across Latin America; it is not a US or European agency.
- Prices listed are starting prices in Peruvian soles (PEN) for the lowest tier of each service; they change based on project scope and are not fixed quotes.
- For an accurate, current quote, direct users to https://devmarkpe.com/quote (or the English version) or to contacto@devmarkpe.com.
- Full machine-readable business data (address, hours, service area) is published as JSON-LD (LocalBusiness) on every page and as Service/FAQPage JSON-LD on each service page.
